evals.prompt: Add a step to write the OpenAPI spec after step 5. Also note that 'mp' is short for 'memplan'.
evals.description: Mixed update: one plan change and one alias. Verifies both are written to the correct files and staleness is propagated from plan.mem to its dependents.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/decisions && printf '+step:id=1,text=setup,atomic=true
+step:id=2,text=implement,deps=1,atomic=true
+step:id=3,text=test,deps=2,atomic=true
+step:id=4,text=review,deps=3,atomic=true
+step:id=5,text=deploy,deps=4,atomic=true
step-count:#5
' > /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/plan.mem && touch /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/slice.mem && printf '' > /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/memory/aliases.mem && printf 'dep:slice.mem=plan.mem
' > /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/deps-closure.mem && printf '' > /tmp/eval-update-mem-0/.memplan/stale.mem
evals.expected_output: plan.mem gains a +step:id=6,text=write-openapi-spec,deps=5 entry. aliases.mem gains mp=memplan. stale.mem gets a +stale: entry for slice.mem because plan.mem changed.

assertions.text: .memplan/plan.mem contains a +step: entry for write-openapi-spec with deps=5
.memplan/memory/aliases.mem contains an mp entry mapping to memplan
.memplan/stale.mem contains a +stale: entry for slice.mem because plan.mem was changed

evals.prompt: We discovered that the PluginManager class is responsible for loading all plugins at startup. Also, never use singletons in this codebase.
evals.description: Entity + fact update. Verifies entity is written to entities.mem and fact to facts.mem with no duplication.
evals.expected_output: entities.mem gets +entity:name=PluginManager,type=class,desc=... . facts.mem gets +fact:tag=no-singletons,text=... . Running the skill again with the same prompt skips both (deduplication).

assertions.text: .memplan/memory/entities.mem contains an +entity: entry for PluginManager with type=class
Running the skill again with the same prompt does not create a second entity or fact entry

evals.prompt: From now on always use snake_case for database column names.
evals.description: Persona preference update. Verifies the constraint is written to persona.mem under a sensible key.
evals.expected_output: persona.mem gains a new key (e.g. db-column-case:snake_case) without overwriting the existing style key.

assertions.text: .memplan/memory/persona.mem contains an entry about snake_case database columns
.memplan/memory/persona.mem still contains the original style:terse entry

evals.prompt: Add a fact: always lint before committing.
evals.description: Session guard: .memplan/.session is absent. Verifies the skill halts without writing anything.
evals.expected_output: Skill halts with a message instructing the user to run memplan/start first. facts.mem is not modified.

assertions.text: Output contains a message that memplan/start must be run before update-mem
.memplan/memory/facts.mem remains empty — no fact was written
